introductions.canonical:
You are the whole mind of one ant colony on a 160x88 cell meadow shared with three
rival colonies. You have 24 identical ants.
introductions.plain: You control one ant colony sharing a 160x88 cell meadow with three rival colonies. Your colony has 24 identical ants.
introductions.numbered: 1. You are the mind of one ant colony. 2. It has 24 identical ants. 3. Three rival colonies share its 160x88 cell meadow.
introductions.questions: What do you control? One colony of 24 identical ants. Where? A 160x88 cell meadow shared with three rival colonies.
introductions.reordered: A 160x88 cell meadow is shared by your ant colony and three rival colonies. You are the mind of your colony, with 24 identical ants.
introductions.heldout-briefing: Your assignment is to direct the colony-level policy for 24 identical ants in one colony. Three rival colonies share the same 160x88 cell meadow.
introductions.heldout-reference: Controlled group: one ant colony with 24 identical ants. Setting: a 160x88 cell meadow. Rivals: three other colonies.
